title: fix: validate proposal creation payload with Zod schema
head: xiaofengzii:fix/proposal-validation-5760
body:
## Summary
This PR adds Zod schema validation for proposal creation payloads.

## Changes
- Add `createProposalSchema` in `apps/api/src/validators/proposal.js` requiring `jobId`, `coverLetter`, `estimatedDuration`, and `rate`
- Validate payload in `proposalController.js` and return 400 for invalid/partial payloads
- Add tests for valid input, missing fields, invalid rate, and extra fields

## Testing
- All tests pass: `node --test src/tests/proposal.test.js`

/claim #743
Closes #5760
